verdict.rationale: CockroachDB ships two official CLIs. The `cockroach` binary is installable via Homebrew and provides `cockroach demo` (in-memory cluster plus SQL shell) and single-node start. The `ccloud` CLI creates, manages and connects to CockroachDB Cloud clusters, including a `ccloud quickstart` command. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI behavior (non-interactive or scriptable modes, machine-readable/JSON output), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI workflows.
